searchText: Calling for discord help from <@!118185622543269890> or others who know discord bots: it looks like the lighthouse discord is flooding with random silent new people, and I got a spam message from one of them. Any experience with this, is there some easy way to block? Also cc <@!361447803194441738> Ah fuck Yeah I have a few methods, particularly bots https://altdentifier.com/ This one is great for stopping raids I can share my settings if interested Also, in one of my servers I use a "emoji to join" set up, makes catching the bots a bit easier They all have the same bitcoin profile pic too, silly bots 😂 It seems to have stopped now, was expecting much worse. Will look at the bot, but maybe not deploy yet. Thanks <@!118185622543269890> No problem! There's no good solution against them unfortunately, even the emoji to join one is a little inconsistent since Discords way of handling invites is unreliable I have seen some people make a bot that watches for the types of profile photos the spam bots use <@!570268431522201601> Can discuss here, thanks for looking at it too proof of work before joining 😉 AltDentifier actually has a captcha for new users lol I banned them all, hope there won't be more. The profile pic definitely made it easy to identify, haha Thanks all, just woke up. Will check this out! Feel free to DM me if you want help setting it up 🙂
